backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing branding and SEO updates with affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting SEO title and description and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React entry component configuring TanStack Router with routes and layout.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Authentication UI component handling Internet Identity login, logout, and status display.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client-side contact form with validation, submission simulation, and success message handling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper including header, footer, and routed page content via Outlet.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer showing business branding, navigation links, and social icons using siteConfig.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation, mobile menu, and authentication controls sourced from siteConfig.
frontend/src/content/siteConfig.ts: Holds static site configuration including business info, navigation, hero text, highlights, about content, and services data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Updates the document title and meta description when a page loads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks tied to backend methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page using siteConfig data with story and values sections and sets meta tags.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays the Contact page with contact info and a form, using siteConfig and page meta.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the home page with hero content, highlights from siteConfig, and a call‑to‑action section using shared UI components.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Displays a services overview with a hero, a grid of service cards from siteConfig, and a CTA section.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project state metadata including versioning, architecture notes, features, and requirements for the business website.
